item.title: Embeddable Multicast DNS daemon
item.description: mdnsd is a small Multicast DNS and DNS-SD (service discovery) responder and library for advertising hosts and services on the local link. It descends from Jeremie Miller’s original mDNS/mDNS-SD daemon and is a lightweight alternative to avahi, small enough to embed in firmware.
